header: Department of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, Faculty of Dentistry, Istanbul Aydın University, Istanbul, Turkey
profile: Elchin Badalov is an associate professor in the Department of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery at Istanbul Aydın University, where he has been a faculty member since 2014 and received the associate-professor title in 2023. He graduated from the Faculty of Dentistry of Istanbul University in 2007 and completed a doctorate there in oral implantology in 2014. His thesis is a histological and histomorphometric study of vascular endothelial growth factor and early bone growth in a mouse model. He has published more than 20 articles and book chapters in maxillofacial surgery and implantology, and has developed two surgical techniques and a suture method that carry his surname.

header: Izmir University of Economics, Izmir, Turkey
profile: Ismihan Bayramoglu is a professor at Izmir University of Economics, where he has worked since 2001. He was dean of the Faculty of Arts and Sciences from 2001 to 2022 and chair of the Department of Mathematics from 2001 to 2015. He received a PhD from Kiev State University in 1988 for a dissertation on invariant confidence intervals and statistical criteria based on training samples. He earned master’s and bachelor’s degrees in applied mathematics from Azerbaijan State University in 1981. From 1993 to 2001 he was a professor in the Department of Statistics at Ankara University. His publications also appear under the spelling Bairamov. He serves on the editorial boards of several international journals and as editor-in-chief of the Statistics journal.

header: Tel Aviv University, Tel Aviv, Israel
profile: Lev Eppelbaum works in the Department of Geosciences at Tel Aviv University. He received an MSc in geophysics from Azerbaijan State University of Oil and Industry in 1982 and a PhD in geophysics in 1989 through the All-Union Geophysical Institute in Baku, the Institute of Geophysics of the Georgian Academy of Sciences in Tbilisi, and the Moscow Mining Academy. He completed postdoctoral studies at Tel Aviv University in 1991–1993 on interpretation and modeling of potential geophysical fields in the Dead Sea Rift. Since October 2020 he has been an honorary professor at Azerbaijan State Oil and Industry University. He has 7,192 Google Scholar citations and an h-index of 46. In 2018–2019 he received the Christian Huygens Medal of the European Geosciences Union. He is a member of the international geophysical commission “Rotation of the Earth” and of the WebmedCentral Ecology Advisory Board.
